sanziene.title: The Night of the Sânziene
sanziene.text: On midsummer night the young women wear crowns of yellow bedstraw and the fairies dance in the clearings. The villages ask leave to light the great fires.

choices.label: Light the fires, and pay for the feast
choices.result: The fires burn till dawn; the people bless your name.

choices.label: Forbid the old rites
choices.result: The fires stay dark, and so do the people's faces.

fae_midsummer.title: The Sânziene Join the Dance
fae_midsummer.text: The kind fairies of midsummer have come down from the meadows of {province} and offer to walk with your court.

choices.label: Welcome them
choices.result: Midsummer Maidens join the court in {province}.

choices.label: Send them home with gifts
choices.result: The people of {province} are glad of it.

strigoi_village.title: A Strigoi in the Village
strigoi_village.text: In {province} the dead walk at night: a fresh grave is found open and the cattle die. The villagers beg for help.

choices.label: Send monster hunters (60 gold)
choices.result: Garlic, a stake and holy water: {province} sleeps in peace.

choices.label: Let the priest deal with it
choices.result: The priest goes up to the graveyard with his censer.

choices.label: It is only peasant talk
choices.result: Fear spreads through {province}.

andrew_night.title: The Night of Saint Andrew
andrew_night.text: On the eve of Saint Andrew the graves open and the strigoi gather at the crossroads. The living rub garlic on doors and windows.

choices.label: Buy garlic for every door (30 gold)
choices.result: The night passes, and nobody is taken.

choices.label: Trust in the bells
choices.result: Something walked the roads that night.

andrew_night_dead.title: The Night of Saint Andrew
andrew_night_dead.text: On the eve of Saint Andrew the graves of {province} open. The dead ask whom they should serve.

choices.label: Raise them for the war
choices.result: The Risen Dead of {province} march under your banner.

choices.label: Let them feast on the living
choices.result: The living of {province} grow fewer, and quieter.

plague.title: Plague
plague.text: A sickness comes up the river roads to {province}. Men fall in the camps and the markets.

choices.label: Close the roads (40 gold)
choices.result: The roads to {province} are shut; the sickness burns itself out.

choices.label: Carry on as usual
choices.result: The plague takes its toll in {province}.

comet.title: A Comet in the Sky
comet.text: For three nights a star with a fiery tail hangs over the mountains. The old women say it means war and death.

choices.label: Have the priests explain it (40 gold)
choices.result: God's sign, say the priests: victory for the righteous.

choices.label: Tell the army it is a sign of victory
choices.result: The soldiers cheer; the peasants still cross themselves.

wedding.title: A Boyar's Wedding
wedding.text: A great boyar of {province} marries his daughter and invites the court. Tradition wants a generous gift.

choices.label: Give a rich gift (60 gold)
choices.result: The boyars of {province} drink to your health.

choices.label: Send your blessing only
choices.result: The boyar takes note.

outlaw_ballad.title: A Ballad of the Outlaws
outlaw_ballad.text: The lute players of {province} sing of an outlaw who robs the rich and feeds the poor. He sends word that he would serve you, if pardoned.

choices.label: Pardon him and his band
choices.result: The outlaws of {province} come down from the forest.

choices.label: Hunt them down (30 gold)
choices.result: The forests of {province} are cleared of outlaws.

harvest.title: A Rich Harvest
harvest.text: The granaries of {province} overflow. The merchants offer to buy what the people cannot eat.

choices.label: Fill the army's granaries
choices.result: Bread for the winter.

choices.label: Sell the surplus
choices.result: The merchants pay in silver.

baba_dochia.title: The Days of Baba Dochia
baba_dochia.text: Old Dochia took off her sheepskins too early, and the March frost came back. The first sowing is ruined.

choices.label: Buy seed grain (50 gold)
choices.result: The fields are sown again.

choices.label: Let the peasants make do
choices.result: A hungry spring.

decebal_treasure.title: The Treasure of Decebal
decebal_treasure.text: Shepherds in {province} have found an old Dacian hoard under a river bed: gold coins with the faces of forgotten kings.

choices.label: Into the treasury
choices.result: The coins clink in your chests.

choices.label: Share it with the finders
choices.result: The shepherds of {province} will sing of your fairness.

wolf_winter.title: A Wolf Winter
wolf_winter.text: The snow lies deep and the wolves come down to the villages. Armies in the field are hard pressed.

choices.label: Send furs and food to the camps (40 gold)
choices.result: The soldiers hold out.

choices.label: The men will manage
choices.result: Frost and wolves thin the ranks.

hermit.title: The Hermit of the Mountain
hermit.text: An old hermit from the forests above {province} asks to speak with one of your generals. He knows the ways of war, he says.

choices.label: Let him teach a general (40 gold)
choices.result: The general comes back from the mountain a wiser man.

choices.label: Send him away
choices.result: The hermit shrugs and goes back to his cave.

hoard_dragon.title: A Rival Wyrm
hoard_dragon.text: A wild balaur has made its lair near {province} and sits on a heap of stolen gold.

choices.label: Fight it for the hoard
choices.result: Steel against fire.

choices.label: Make it one of your own
choices.result: The wyrm bows its three heads to you.

saxon_merchants.title: Saxon Merchants
saxon_merchants.text: Traders from the walled towns of Transylvania offer good steel and grain for silver.

choices.label: Buy grain (60 gold)
choices.result: Wagons of grain roll in.

choices.label: Buy steel for the troops (90 gold)
choices.result: New blades and mail for the army.

choices.label: Nothing today
choices.result: The merchants move on.
